name: eevee-light-shader-volume-probe-bake
purpose: Verify that Eevee Light Shader Output affects Volume Probe / Irradiance Grid bake direct lighting through the surfel-space light shader path.
passCriteria: The test must bake a small Volume Probe scene, render the baked irradiance through Light Probe Color, and prove default pass-through matches the non-custom path while custom color, custom attenuation, and Light Space-driven variation are present in the baked irradiance result.
